hero.title: cookieheaven
hero.lede: I love the world, and I believe knowledge is its most powerful tool — the one thing that grows when it is shared, the one treasure that teaches us how to see.

about.heading: A small doctrine
paragraphs: The world is stranger, larger, and more beautiful than it first appears. To learn is to keep meeting it again with better eyes.
Knowledge is not decoration. It is our most valuable asset: a way to name what is real, resist what is false, and become less easily ruled by fear.
This is a small archive of things I make, things I notice, and questions I refuse to stop asking.
